reasons.plausibility: Cu is largely immiscible in many refractory HEA matrices and tends to form embrittling phases at grain boundaries, making the claim of preserved structural integrity under cyclic loading at 600–800°C scientifically doubtful.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific processing, cycling conditions, quantitative thresholds for falsification, and appropriate characterization techniques.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a relevant property trade-off but relies on a well-known problematic alloying strategy (Cu in high-temperature alloys) without acknowledging key prior evidence, limiting its practical value.
